agentSessions.import.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: imports transcripts of the last 30 days (max 100) as threads with the last 200 text messages and the native session id so the provider resumes; idempotent. Tool calls and thinking are not reconstructed; transcripts are never written.

agentSessions.scan.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: scans $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects and $CODEX_HOME/sessions (bounded files/bytes/line length, read-only, nothing cached), groups by directory, reports matching projects and alreadyImported.

assets.createUrl.note: Real-client signed grants cover all resource tags, Range/HEAD, session/scope/canonical-boundary rechecks. GTK theme inheritance/XDG icon downloads, content-selected cached media and expired-cache collection tested. Partial: MCP HTML injection, complete platform discovery, media formats/host adapters. Tool-output images require orchestration:read; file grants require filesystem:read.

attachments.createUploadUrl.note: Real-client test (files_assets): HMAC-signed 10 min grant, type/size limits (10 MiB image, 50 MiB file), pending-<uuid>[-ext] ids. Token layout matches T3.

attachments.delete.note: Real-client test: removes pending uploads (and .txt sidecar), idempotent, ignores non-pending or malformed ids. Upload route: streamed to a .part file, exact size, 204, 409 on conflicting duplicate.

device.action.note: tests/device.rs real t3-protocol client with fake adb on PATH: connected authorized local Android discovery, configure, sessions, detail, PNG screenshots, key input and subscription cancellation. No boot/shutdown, emulator creation, iOS, SSH/EAS, tool installation, H264 video, full detail/settings or action parity; unsupported operations return typed reasons. Per-subscription polling only while subscribed; no idle adb process. Desktop with installed decoder does not fall back to PNG.

orchestration.dispatchCommand.note: Partial after independent audit: actual client Command/approval/queue/timeline/sidebar/awareness readers now execute on server output; acceptForSession survives actual idle reap; semantic title generation honors settings and guarded completion. Imported native references on thread.create now share launch validation and atomic persistence, exercised with ThreadCreate and real projection/timeline/queue readers. Remaining: durable-versus-native control delivery boundary; retained partial by the final reader sweep. See CONFORMANCE.md.

orchestration.getArchivedShellSnapshot.note: Real-client test: archived threads and projects with the shared sequence. Built from the in-memory shell assembly (10,000 thread cap), same limit as the live shell.

orchestration.getFullThreadDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures Git refs and verifies baseline-to-turn diff. Checkpoint retention and overlapping-workspace isolation remain.

orchestration.getOlderSettledThreads.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: pages settled top-level threads below the cursor (settledAt desc, id asc), limit 0 returns per-project counts, project filter. Snapshots never omit older settled threads, so capabilities.shellOlderSettled stays false.

orchestration.getThreadFamily.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.getThreadProjection.note: Real-client test: bounded projection (up to 100 rows per kind) and an error for unknown threads.

orchestration.getTurnDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures baseline/end refs using a private Git index; test verifies diff over a real workspace change. Includes untracked nonignored files and deletions; non-Git workspaces report unavailable.

orchestration.getTurnItem.note: Real-client test: item by id for its own thread, null otherwise. The revision argument is ignored.

orchestration.getWorkflowScript.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: reads .js files below $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR|~/.claude/projects, 256 KiB cap, T3's typed OrchestrationGetWorkflowScriptError reasons.

orchestration.getWorktreeThreadIds.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.launchThread.note: Real ThreadLaunch builder covers creation, empty reuse and receipt replay; actual projection/timeline/queue/sidebar readers and title-generation tests cover settings, fallback and rename races. Worktree rollback and native steering peers remain covered. Final client-read sweep: zero remaining consumed gaps; see CONFORMANCE.md.

orchestration.searchThread.note: Real Connection verifies rendered Markdown blocks, hidden link/context destinations, skill labels, folded-answer exclusion, canonical ordering and index/start/offset navigation. Partial: rich file/citation/artifact labels, legacy context envelopes and full upstream Markdown pipeline.

orchestration.searchThreadStream.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.searchThreads.note: Real Connection verifies metadata, shells, project/state filters, FTS plus folded substring fallback (4096 rows, 64K characters/row, 8 MiB scanned text), and title exact/prefix/substring priority. Partial: full palette word-boundary/recency/branch/pick scoring and matches beyond the fallback budget.

orchestration.stopWorkflow.note: No provider control stops a workflow; answers OrchestrationV2StopWorkflowError(unsupported). tests/admin_reads.rs.

orchestration.subscribeArchivedShell.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.subscribeCommandOutput.note: Real Connection verifies bounded command tails, replacement/final output. Bounded CR/backspace/CSI progress folding handles split sequences and long rewritten lines. Real Claude 2.1.316 Bash probe supplies output only at completion; Codex exposes outputDelta. Partial: live Claude command output unavailable on observed protocol; arbitrary multiline VT unsupported.

orchestration.subscribeShell.note: Real Connection background/identity/replay coverage plus Codex quota failure/reset and usage_limit error class via schema-based synthetic native peer; Claude rejection reset/error class projected. Still partial: required realistic captured exhausted-provider failure frame is unavailable; synthetic evidence is explicitly not a real capture. See CONFORMANCE.md.

orchestration.subscribeThread.note: Internal execution/recovery bookkeeping is excluded from run records, snapshots, history, replay and cached launch receipts; legacy databases migrate without losing continuation. Real gated Codex vs isolated T3 3991 concurrency test exercises two subscribers, queued dispatches, pin/unsettle, interrupt/hold/resume and real lib reducers/readers. Fixed queued_turn intent, Codex queue capability and the attempt event tag. Partial: missing run_interrupt_request/result timeline activities; full reduced-record equality and broader native delivery/recovery remain unproved. See concurrent-reader-report.json and CONFORMANCE.md.
